name: Dell 1996
look: A literal black page frame around flat colour-block ribbon cards, Arial Black titles over Times body, and hand-cut GIF stickers.

hero.title: THE COMPUTER YOU ACTUALLY ORDERED
hero.sub: Configure it, we build it, it ships in five days. No middleman, no shelf stock, no paying for a component you did not want.

features.title: FOUR LINES, ONE CATALOG
features.sub: Each family is built to order from the same parts bin, so the configuration is yours rather than a bundle.

items.title: LATITUDE — NOTEBOOKS
items.body: Portable systems from 5.9 lbs, with a docking station that does not require a second power brick.

items.title: OPTIPLEX GX — DESKTOPS
items.body: Managed desktops with a chassis that opens without tools and a documented parts list.

items.title: POWEREDGE — SERVERS
items.body: Rack and tower servers with hot-swap drives and a three-year on-site contract.

items.title: AXIONWARE — SOFTWARE
items.body: Preinstalled and licensed, with the media in the box rather than a recovery partition.

items.title: 1-800 ORDERING
items.body: A person answers. They can read your configuration back to you and change it.

items.title: FIVE-DAY SHIP
items.body: Built after you order and shipped within five business days, or the freight is free.

showcases.title: NEXT-BUSINESS-DAY ON SITE
showcases.body: A technician comes to you the next business day for the length of the warranty. Parts are stocked regionally, so the visit and the part arrive together rather than in two separate weeks.
points: Technician on site next business day

showcases.title: WE SELL DIRECT
showcases.body: No dealer network and no retail markup. You configure the machine, we build that machine, and the price on the page is the price you pay.
points: Configured to order, not from stock
Price on the page is the price

testimonial.quote: I called the 800 number, changed the drive size, and the man read the whole configuration back to me. Then it arrived on Thursday exactly as described.
testimonial.name: H. R. Whitfield

pricing.title: ORDER
pricing.sub: Configure and order direct. No dealer, no markup.

items.a: Five business days from order for a standard configuration. If we miss that, the freight is on us — that is a policy, not a goodwill gesture.

items.q: Can I change my configuration after ordering?
items.a: Yes, until it enters the build queue, which is usually the following morning. Call the 800 number and the representative can amend it.
A technician at your location the next business day for the warranty term, with the part in hand. Parts are stocked regionally so the two arrive together.
Thirty days, money back, for any reason. You pay the return freight unless the system was misconfigured by us.

cta.title: CONFIGURE YOUR SYSTEM
cta.sub: Built after you order and shipped in five business days.

notes: Every page sits inside a literal black outer frame about 8px thick — the design treats the browser window as a printed picture frame.
Flat colour-block ribbon cards tint each product family with its own catalogue colour. No gradients, no shadows, no opacity anywhere.
Type is three-tier: a chunky black display for section titles, a bold sans for product rows, and Times for all body copy.
Hand-cut GIF stickers overlay the layout — a yellow tab in the corner, angled NEW bursts, round award seals.
Dell red is reserved for exactly two things: the main CTA panel and the phone number. It is never decorative.
